Q: Update C++Builder Rio from 10.3.2 to 10.3.3 A:

Minor point updates are usually available via GetIt. Did you look there?

Unfortunately, installing 10.3.3 over 10.3.2 requires a full re-install. This is stated in the 10.3.3 release notes:

If you have already installed 10.3 Rio (November 22nd, 2018), 10.3 Rio - Release 1 (February 14th, 2019) or 10.3 Rio - Release 2 (July 18th, 2019), installing 10.3 Rio - Release 3 requires a full uninstall and reinstall. As part of the uninstall process, you will see an option for preserving your settings. Separately, you can also preserve settings with Settings Migration Tool.

Also, once you do get 10.3.3 installed, make sure you install all available patches for 10.3.3, too.

Q: How can I remove all text after a character in Bash? A:

I know some solutions:

# Our mock data:
A=user:mail:password

  1. With AWK and a pipe:

    echo $A | awk -v FS=':' '{print $1}'

    Output:

    user

  2. Via Bash variables:

    echo ${A%%:*}

    Output:

    user

  3. With a pipe and sed:

    echo $A | sed 's#:.*##g'

    Output:

    user

  4. With a pipe and grep:

    echo $A | egrep -o '^[^:]+'

    Output:

    user

  5. With a pipe and cut:

    echo $A | cut -f1 -d\:

    Output:

    user
